name: bendo-desktop
description: Bendo Electron shell — loads local Bendo (Docker/Next); does not embed the web UI
author: Bendo

scripts.pack: npm run build:bendo && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:bendo && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg
